name: Legal Aid Society of San Mateo County
description: Free legal help for housing, healthcare access, economic security, immigration, education, and freedom from violence and abuse
fullDescription: The Legal Aid Society of San Mateo County provides free civil legal services to low-income residents, helping protect their rights and improve their lives.
whatTheyOffer:
- Housing law (eviction, habitability, lock-outs, utility shut-offs, subsidized housing, fair housing)
- Health care access through the Health Consumer Center (Medi-Cal, insurance)
- Public benefits (CalWORKs, SSI, Social Security, CAPI, CalFresh)
- Immigration assistance and public charge information
- Special education and services for children with disabilities
- Protection from domestic violence and elder abuse
howToGetIt:
1. Call 650-558-0915 to find out how Legal Aid can help and schedule an appointment
2. Tenants with housing issues can call 650-517-8911
3. Complete eligibility screening (for low-income San Mateo County residents)
4. Describe your legal issue
5. Receive legal advice, brief services, or full representation (no traffic or criminal cases)
address: 330 Twin Dolphin Drive, Suite 123, Redwood City, CA 94065
keywords: Legal Aid, San Mateo County, free lawyer, eviction defense, housing, Medi-Cal, public benefits, immigration, education rights, domestic violence, abuse, low-income legal
